project_type: Local-first AI runtime — Python stdlib HTTP server + vanilla JS single-page Studio
build_system: setuptools (pyproject.toml). No compile step. Install: pip install -e '.[local]'. Core has zero required deps — stdlib only. Optional extras: local, browser, vision, chart, memory, aws, server, train, dev.
test_framework: python3 scripts/smoke_urai.py (primary, ~30 checks, ~6s, offline). pytest exists in dev extra but NOT installed in current env. No tests/ directory populated.
build_command: pip install -e '.[local]'  # or pip install -e '.[all]' for full install
verification_instructions: Run 'python3 scripts/smoke_urai.py' from repo root. Must print 'all smoke checks passed'. Check runs in /home/kp/urai-work/urai. Server startup: 'urai serve start --model qwen3-4b --ctx 32768' then 'urai api --port 8777'. Health check: 'curl http://localhost:8777/health'.
environment_constraints: No pytest installed — use smoke_urai.py. Worktree: /home/kp/urai-work/urai. Git remote: https://github.com/etside/urai.git. Never push to main directly — commit to branch, push with -u, create PR. Data dir: data/ under repo root (or URAI_DATA_DIR env). llama-server binary at third_party/llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-server. Server runs on port 8777 (API) and 8080 (llama-server).
contribution_requirements: Apache 2.0 license — no proprietary or AGPL-only deps. Stdlib-only core path must be preserved (new features go in optional extras or handle ImportError gracefully). All imports of optional packages must be wrapped in try/except ImportError with informative error message. Match existing code style: single-file modules, dataclasses for persistence, JSON files in data/.
key_patterns: 1. Routes added as if/elif blocks in do_GET/do_POST/do_DELETE of Handler class in server.py. 2. Tools added as functions in tools.py, registered in TOOLS dict and TOOL_SCHEMAS list. 3. Persistence: JSON files in data/ subdirectory. 4. Lazy imports inside functions (not at module top) for optional deps. 5. Events/SSE: use _stream_backend() pattern — send_response(200), set Content-Type text/event-stream, write 'data: {...}\n\n' chunks. 6. Auth gate: routes under /v1/ go through _check_access(); master key bypasses. 7. Studio panels: add tab to .sb-nav, add div.panel#panel-X, show/hide via showPanel('X'). 8. CLI: add sub-parsers to argparse in cli.py, wire to module functions.
directory_structure: repo root: jev/ (Python package), jev/static/ (app.html + PWA assets), data/ (JSON stores: routines.json, sched_jobs.json, focus.json, workspace/), third_party/llama.cpp/ (llama-server binary), scripts/ (smoke_urai.py, distill/, train_pipeline.py), docs/, configs/, deploy/, desktop/ (Electron), android/ (WebView APK), bin/ (urai/jev shell wrappers), tests/ (empty).
